levelA.statement: Single source of truth. One fact has one canonical owner; others reference, cache presentation, or derive — never co-own.
levelA.observed: Multi-domain mechanical definitions found for 14 responsibilities (`mechanical-authority-census.json`) — Phase 2

levelA.statement: Mutation gate. Actor state and owned-item state change only through `ActorEngine` (`scripts/governance/actor-engine/actor-engine.js`). Exceptions: world documents not owned by an actor, Foundry-only operations, each with a code comment.
levelA.observed: **331** direct document-write sites in **120** live modules (155 `setFlag`, 48 `unsetFlag`, 35 `update`, 19 `create`, 19 `delete`, …). Highest: talents 72, combat 25, equipment 24, mentor 24, npc-followers 23, force 23

levelA.statement: Derived state ownership. `actor.system.derived` is computed by the V2 actor classes / derived calculators and read-only elsewhere.
Presentation separation. Sheets, apps and templates render prepared data and emit intents; they do not compute rules or mutate documents.
levelA.observed: 54 direct writes in 26 live presentation modules (largest: `scripts/items/swse-item-sheet.js` 19, `scripts/apps/minion-manager.js` 8)

levelA.statement: Settings rule. House-rule reads in engines go through `HouseRuleService`.
Dependency direction. Engines do not import UI; dependencies flow downward; no cycles.
levelA.observed: 45 engine→UI import edges in 36 live engine modules; 9 static cycles (52 files); 31 domains in one SCC

levelA.statement: No mutation during render or in read-only/prepare phases; no recursive engine invocation; deterministic order.
Clean cutover. Legacy V1 systems stay retired; no compatibility shims, runtime monkey-patches, crosswalks or parallel authorities; old paths are rerouted then removed.
levelA.source: ARCHITECTURE §VIII; progression-architecture ("no runtime patching"); E3-A4 OA-1; OSI
levelA.observed: 17 live hotfix modules (`scripts/patches/**`, 3,939 SLOC); **20 prototype monkey-patches** (e.g. `TalentStep.prototype.*` in `telekinetic-prodigy-runtime-patches.js` and `custom-talent-tree-progression-overlay.js`; `SWSEItemSheet.prototype._onRender`); 64 live modules marked deprecated

levelA.statement: Credits. `TransactionEngine` (`scripts/engine/store/transaction-engine.js`) is the single source of truth for credit movement; no parallel ledgers; a trade is atomic — any failure fails the whole trade.
levelA.observed: 15 credit-payload sites in 11 live modules outside TransactionEngine, incl. `scripts/engine/store/ledger-service.js:149,211`, `summary-step.js:1786`, `character-like-sheet.js:6087`, `progression-event-processor.js:409`

levelA.statement: Rules authority. Claude implements; it does not adjudicate ambiguous rules. Unresolved mechanics are `DEFERRED_RULES_REVIEW` in `docs/audits/swse-rules-decisions-pending.md`.
levelA.observed: Not probed; contracts cite the register

levelA.statement: Automation authority. The system executes rules from verified state and supplied context; unknown is not false; GM adjudicates circumstances.
Certification separation. `FOUNDRY_TESTED` only from a live Foundry V13 run; offline tests and CI are not runtime acceptance.
levelA.observed: Phases 0–2 make no live claim; step1 runbook is **NOT EXECUTED**

levelA.statement: Unified actor shell. character, droid, npc and vehicle actors use the unified V2 shell (`SWSEV2CharacterSheet` direction); no new standalone actor sheets; Holopad/Shell Host replaces older floating UIs.
levelA.observed: `index.js:175-199` registers `SWSEV2NpcSheet`, `SWSEV2DroidSheet`, `SWSEV2VehicleSheet` separately; whether they are thin subclasses of the shared shell is checked in Phase 2

levelA.statement: Progression authority. Chargen/level-up route through `ProgressionShell` / `ChargenShell` / `LevelupShell`; temporary choices live in session/draft state; finalization commits once through `ProgressionFinalizer` → `ActorEngine.applyMutationPlan`.
levelA.observed: All named authorities exist and are reachable

levelA.statement: Caching discipline. Cache display/derived work only, each with an explicit invalidation key; never cache permissions, credits, HP truth, roll/damage results or live documents.
levelA.observed: 19 cache-holding live modules; 2 with no visible invalidation (`talent-step.js`, `sentinel-source-mapper.js`)

levelA.statement: Customization authority. `ItemCustomizationWorkbench`, `CustomizationWorkflow`, `UpgradeSlotEngine`, `UpgradeService`, `CustomizationBayApp`, droid/vehicle customization engines, lightsaber workbench. Old per-item modification apps stay retired.
levelA.observed: All named authorities exist and are reachable

levelA.statement: Rules exclusions the implementation must respect (no D&D crit confirmation; lightsabers ignore DR by default; weapon damage adds ½ heroic level unless excluded; Force powers do not add ½ level by default; droids cannot benefit from organic resting; Nonheroic is not a player class).
levelA.observed: Verified per domain in Phase 2 where code paths exist
